item.title: The price was right. Yesterday.
item.description: A cache can improve latency while returning stale information. Between Redis and business rules, how long can we afford a value to be wrong?

item.title: The PR was green. The problem was still there.
item.description: GitHub migrated Copilot to Rust with agents writing over 800,000 lines. One compatibility check raised a better question: who gets to decide the work is done?

item.title: The question remains
item.description: Closing a story does not always close the question that surfaced along the way. Out of Context is where I return to understand what happened.
